Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.
Changelog: New: Warrior, rebuilt from the game's own data. Beast Gauge turns red when a spender is ready and can flash while Nascent Chaos is on. Inner Release pips, Surging Tempest bar with its seconds, combo pips that follow the combo you are in (3 after Heavy Swing, 2 after Overpower), and auras that work as timers: wings for Primal Rend (30 s) and Primal Ruination (20 s), and an arch above your character for Primal Wrath (Wrathful, 30 s). Each piece has its own settings card. Layout: Pixel perfect checkbox to place elements in real screen pixels at any scale. Size fields now move 1 px at a time. Fixes: dragging in unlock mode follows the mouse at any Interface scale. Game windows now cut the HUD only when they are real windows (menus, logs, maps) plus chat and hotbars, so banners such as Duty Commence and other on-screen text no longer hide it.
